items.title: Jahmyr Gibbs: Hits paydirt three times against Chicago
items.text:
Gibbs carried the ball 21 times for 205 yards and three touchdowns while catching all five of his targets for 47 yards in Thursday's 39-35 loss to the Bears.

items.title: Caleb Williams: Calls himself 'fine' after Thursday's game
items.text:
